additional_info.subject: RE: AW: RE:ID0464386-DC/Si-D/CH-[RVP / T2 170004480] CP2 Out of Service CRM:03055000388
additional_info.body:
Hello Alexander,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0464386.
Here is a summary of my messages via Teams:
Today I checked the charger, and outlet DC2 was OoO. From the error flags, I could see the following:
Due to the configuration of the charger, the primary converter group for DC2 is only #1 converter, TB9. If this converter has issue, for example in this case "Can CommunicationLost", the whole CGp (primary converter group) for DC2 is unavailable, as a consequence DC2 is set OoO.
I checked via DEBUG station, and there was no converter for DC2. By triggering a converter group via change configuration, the communication to the converter was re-established and DC2 was again available.
Later this afternoon, I checked an ongoing charging session, and TB9 of DC2 at first worked properly. The charger was charging on DC1 at full power, with CG of DC2 included:
2025-12-01T15:08:32.782737+00:00 [FW080005G2] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [CGA]  |T1|CG.UseID|
001 001 001 001
|CG.Share|00 01 01 01|DCx.ChrgPh|06 00 00 00|DCx.Pilot|C2  A  A  A|DCx.SMbyp|0 1 1 1|OGC.Fbk|1 0 0 0|SMC.Fbk|1 0 1 1|DPA.aPwr|200 000 000 000|EV.TarPwr|194 000 000 000|DPA.Opt|1NN 0NN 0NN 0NN|
2025-12-01T15:09:22.720444+00:00 [FW080005G2] swcpu [user:debug] [4322] [DCC]  |ID=14|DC1: |EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=199|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=300|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=196.1|EVSE_NowCur[A]=297|EVSE_NowVol[V]=660.4|EV_TarCur[A]=297|EV_TarVol[V]=677|EV_SOC[%]=23|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=200|Cable_Max[A]=400|Phase=6
At 2025-12-01T15:50:33, Can communication with TB9 was lost again, CG for DC2 did not contribute to power delivery anymore, and DC2 was set to OoO. From the Debug station, you can see how DC2 has no active converters found:
In conclusion, the issue could be in the 40kW power converter itself (position TB9, power converter SN:
2102313PAVNSQ4000568
), or in the connection to the power converter (less likely).
Therefore, it is necessary to go onsite, check the connection to TB9, and in case replace the power converter. Here is the spare part to be ordered:
I will be moving ticket
ID0464386
to the
eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue
.
Kindly pick up the case using "Pick" option in the queue or manually using the "Assign" function from the
eMobility RC-CH SI E Queue
and work on it & document the activity (Logs/Field Service Report) and attach it to the case under Documents Tab on ISP.
In case you require Expert Support, kindly create Work-order as per
unified service process
. If you need assistance with ordering Expert Support, feel free to reach out to Sousa, Afonso (SI E CS SD) at
afonso-sousa@siemens.com
or Teodoso, Rui (SI E CS SD ES) at
rui.teodoso@siemens.com
.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer

Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com

Thank you.
